title: Explore a maze with a breadth-first frontier
audience: Students with basic programming knowledge who are learning assembly
prerequisites: Leaf function calls and publication checkpoints
learningObjectives: Bound a monotone byte queue with discovery-time marking
Validate geometry before flattening cell IDs
Reconstruct and verify a shortest predecessor chain
Publish frontier, processed cells, and final route consistently

progression.localImplementation: Text guides and complete-program CLI checks

quiz.prompt: What does this task minimize?

choices.text: The number of cells stored in the maze.

hints.text: Count moves between cells.
The start contributes a cell but no move.
